resources.string: Live readout of the camera (lat/lon/alt/heading/tilt) and lookAt, plus above-horizon and selected position.
Move the camera to a point (focusOnLocation) or frame an area (focusOnSector).
Switch between Normal / AR / VR, tune the AR distance limit, and toggle reticle & map visibility.
Pin and unpin the map cursor and observe isCursorPinned and the selected position.
Magnetic declination, grid convergence and angle correction, plus distance/azimuth and terrain elevation.

camera and lookAt are plain snapshots (not flows), so they are re-read on every mapNavigatorEvent. isLookAtAboveHorizon and selectedPosition are observed directly as StateFlows. Pan, zoom or tilt the map to see the values update.

focusOnLocation centers the camera on a single point; focusOnSector frames a bounding area. Each call is followed by requestRedraw so the camera move is painted immediately. Both target the Kyiv demo location. "Focus on cursor" moves to the current selectedPosition; "Focus on user" moves to the user\'s GPS location (no-op if unavailable).

updateMapDisplayMode switches the map between Normal, AR and VR. In AR mode the distance limit caps how far AR symbols are drawn. The reticle and map-visibility toggles are independent of the mode. Settings are reset when you leave this screen.
pinCursor freezes the cursor at the screen center so the selected position no longer follows the map; unpinCursor releases it. The buttons are gated on isCursorPinned.

getDeclination, getConvergence and getAngleCorrection report the magnetic & grid corrections at the lookAt. The GeoHelper (inherited) getDistanceAndAngle returns the distance and azimuth from the camera to the selected position, and getElevation returns the terrain elevation under the lookAt. Values refresh on every mapNavigatorEvent.
